# WatsoNova Košice

> WatsoNova is a new residential project in the center of Košice, which is being built on the site of the former Eastern Slovak Printing House - just a few minutes walk from the historical center of the city. The project will offer modern apartments with thoughtful layouts from 1-room to spacious 5-room units, underground parking, and up to 9,500 m² of commercial and business space.

## Fakta
- Typ: byt
- Druh nabídky: predaj
- Dispozice: 2-izbový
- Plocha: 108.3 m²
- Podlaží: 3
- Stav: novostavba
- Vlastnictví: osobné
- Lokalita: Košice
- Cena: 519 900 €
